summary: Generic MCP V1 hardened in isolation; awaiting current-head integration, full regression and live Claude acceptance.
reason: Resume the preserved candidate after verifying the earlier external write denial had no effect. Current Claude Pro/Max connector documentation supports fixed request headers, so V1 keeps per-client bearer authentication and does not add an OAuth server.

capabilities.reason: Provider-neutral external_mcp surface with exact-resolution read-only admission; business result projection and artifact access are bounded to canonical receipts. Not deployed yet.

architecture.reason: Generic external MCP adapter reuses existing edge relay, Capability Harness/Graph, Remote Bridge receipts and Memory Core; no provider-specific router or OAuth subsystem is introduced.

rollback: Before deployment, discard/revert the isolated branch. After deployment, disable the MCP client secret/edge route and revert the scoped commits; Samantha/Slack/RDC paths are independent.
limitations: Full regression after reconciliation with current canonical heads is pending.
Real Claude custom-connector E2E and latency are pending.
Production runtime is unchanged until explicit deployment and runtime verification.
Only chat-owner-shadow read-only execution is in scope for V1.
